provenance.who: a coding-agent session (coordinator), from speeds-kit docs/TAPGRADE.md ('the chain') and userscripts/tapgrade.user.js, TapGrade 0.6.6
provenance.note: Written from what the 0.6.6 code and its mock-Canvas audit do, not from a person using it on a phone: nobody has run this on real Canvas yet. Amounts and similarities are guesses. Judgments: (1) a before/after that is one tap away counts as on screen for the Apply COMMIT; (2) Apply is irreversible (TapGrade has no undo; the text from before stays on the phone), Resume and Retry failed are idempotent (they write only what still differs); (3) docs/TAPGRADE.md calls the tap on Update Canvas after a refresh a RE-ORIENT, kept here. The hand-designed target that the code was built toward is hw1_correction_pass_fixed.json; this file is what was built.
